releaseDateSource: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html: "9.0.2 was released on 2026-09-18." (confirmed by the independent reviewer on 2026-10-20, #39 c-6290077471)

signingKey.note: FFmpeg release signing key as published on https://ffmpeg.org/download.html. Cross-checked 2026-10-20 by the independent reviewer (rendered page, #39 c-6290077471) and by Codex (official website source FFmpeg/web@0e960d6 and the downloaded key, PR83 review 5584543124). verify-source.sh refuses any key whose fingerprint differs.

tarballSha256Note: Recorded from the first signature-verified CI download (run 39348016177, 2026-10-20) and reproduced by every build since (runs 39348453561, 39348796862, 39349144271, 39349445007, 39349763926, 39350044354, 39350436723: two independent downloads each). A changed value fails verify-source.sh and is a review event.
sourceDateEpochNote: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH = 2026-09-18T00:00:00Z (the release date), fixed. At c45319d build.sh used the downloaded tarball file mtime, i.e. the download time, which differed per job; the binaries were identical regardless, so FFmpeg does not embed it, but the recorded value was misleading (independent review F2).
expectedBinarySha256Note: Reproduced by 12 independent builds (runs 39349445007..39351040405) with the final configure.flags on ubuntu-24.04 image 20261012.334.1. provenance.mjs validate fails the build if a binary differs: a changed digest is a review event (toolchain/image or recipe drift), never silently accepted.
